chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The lowest form of knowledge is that which remains on the tongue, and the most superior form is that which manifests itself through the limbs and the organs of the body.

key_terms.الْأَرْكَانِ: Pillars/Foundations (often referring to the pillars of the body or acts of worship)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the lowest and highest forms of knowledge in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes a hierarchy of knowledge where mere verbal recitation represents the lowest tier, while true wisdom is validated by its manifestation in the limbs and actions. This distinction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'ilm al-amali' (practical knowledge), asserting that intellectual understanding must culminate in physical practice to be considered complete and authentic.
